say: Con binoculares, Leo vio a un gran OSO POLAR caminando sobre el hielo del mar, lejos y a salvo. “¡Mira sus patas!”, dijo Zazá. “Enormes, ¡como raquetas de nieve! Y también nada con ellas, como remos”. “Un verdadero oso de mar”, susurró Leo.

say: A little white fox began following them everywhere — the ARCTIC FOX! “In summer, her coat turns brown,” said sah-SAH. “In winter, white as snow. Only her black nose gives her away!” The fox winked her black nose at them.

say: Una zorrita blanca empezó a seguirlos a todos lados: ¡la ZORRA ÁRTICA! “En verano, su pelaje se vuelve café”, dijo Zazá. “En invierno, blanco como la nieve. ¡Solo su nariz negra la delata!” La zorra les guiñó con su nariz negra.

say: Suddenly the wind HOWLED and the snow whirled — a BLIZZARD! Everything turned white; Leh-oh couldn't even see the station! “Don't panic,” said sah-SAH in his ear. “The guide rope, Leh-oh. Remember the rope!”

say: De repente el viento AULLÓ y la nieve giró: ¡una TORMENTA DE NIEVE! Todo se puso blanco; ¡Leo ni siquiera veía la estación! “No entres en pánico”, dijo Zazá en su oído. “La cuerda guía, Leo. ¡Recuerda la cuerda!”

say: Leh-oh found the rope — there! He held it with BOTH hands. “Step by step,” he called. “I've got the rope! Follow me!” Hand over hand, step by step, Leh-oh led everyone along the rope until — the red station door! They were HOME.

say: While the blizzard sang outside, everyone sipped cocoa by the stove, cheeks rosy. The little fox curled up asleep by the door. “You stayed calm and led the way,” said Dr. Nils. “That's what a leader does, Leh-oh.”

say: “Mission 8!” said sah-SAH. “A hurricane is spinning over the warm sea — a giant storm pinwheel!” On the big screen, the spiral turned slowly. “Today,” said Captain Vega, handing them headsets, “we fly INTO it. We are the Hurricane Hunters.”

say: “¡Misión 8!”, dijo Zazá. “¡Un huracán está girando sobre el mar tibio: una rueda gigante de tormenta!” En la pantalla grande, la espiral giraba despacio. “Hoy”, dijo la Capitana Vega, dándoles los audífonos, “volamos DENTRO de él. Somos los Cazadores de Huracanes”.

say: Outside stood their plane: big, white and extra strong, built for storms. “Most planes fly AWAY from hurricanes,” said Captain Vega. “Ours flies in — on purpose! We go to measure the storm, so everyone on land can get ready.”

say: Afuera esperaba su avión: grande, blanco y extra fuerte, hecho para tormentas. “Casi todos los aviones vuelan LEJOS de los huracanes”, dijo la Capitana Vega. “El nuestro vuela hacia adentro, ¡a propósito! Vamos a medir la tormenta, para que todos en tierra puedan prepararse”.

say: Inside, screens glowed and seatbelts clicked. Beside Leh-oh sat a rack of tube-shaped instruments with tiny parachutes. “Dropsondes,” said sah-SAH. “We drop them into the storm, and they radio back the numbers. Leh-oh — the countdown is YOUR job.”

say: Adentro, las pantallas brillaban y los cinturones hacían clic. Junto a Leo había una fila de instrumentos con forma de tubo y paracaídas diminutos. “Sondas”, dijo Zazá. “Las soltamos dentro de la tormenta, y envían los números por radio. Leo, la cuenta regresiva es TU trabajo”.

say: Up, up they flew! Below, the warm sea sparkled deep blue, and the storm's cloud bands curved in a great spiral. “Hurricanes are born over warm water,” said sah-SAH. “And they spin — like the biggest top in the world!”

say: ¡Arriba, arriba volaron! Abajo, el mar tibio brillaba azul profundo, y las bandas de nubes de la tormenta se curvaban en una gran espiral. “Los huracanes nacen sobre el agua tibia”, dijo Zazá. “Y giran… ¡como el trompo más grande del mundo!”

say: Then — the rain bands! Gray clouds swallowed the plane. Rain streaked the windows, and the plane bumped and danced. BUMP… bump-bump… Leh-oh held his straps and breathed slowly. “Steady, team,” said the Captain. “Steady…”

say: Entonces… ¡las bandas de lluvia! Las nubes grises se tragaron el avión. La lluvia rayaba las ventanas, y el avión se sacudía y bailaba. ¡PUM!… pum-pum… Leo agarró sus cinturones y respiró despacio. “Firmes, equipo”, dijo la Capitana. “Firmes…”

say: Ahead rose the EYEWALL — a towering wall of swirling cloud, the wildest part of the storm. “This ring has the strongest winds of all,” said sah-SAH, holding Leh-oh's hand. “Through it… and then — you'll see. Ready, Leh-oh?”

say: The plane shook — roared — and then… SILENCE. Golden sunlight! Blue sky! They were inside THE EYE: calm as a swimming pool, with a stadium of clouds standing all around. “It's… SUNNY in here,” whispered Leh-oh.

say: “Dropsonde time!” said the Captain. Leh-oh opened his checklist. Four drops to make — no more, no less. “Drop one… ready?” He watched the mark on the screen. “THREE… TWO… ONE… DROP!”
